title: 3 Day Tsavo East Safari from Mombasa, Diani or Watamu
rank_math_title: Tsavo East Safari from Mombasa: 3 Days from the Coast
rank_math_desc: Tsavo East safari from Mombasa, Diani or Watamu in 3 days: red elephants, Aruba Dam and Lugard Falls, two nights at Voi Wildlife Lodge.
post_content: This Tsavo East safari is the easiest way to add real wildlife to a beach holiday on the Kenya coast.
overview:
This Tsavo East safari is the easiest way to add real wildlife to a beach holiday on the Kenya coast. We collect you from your hotel in Mombasa, Diani, Watamu or Malindi and drive to Tsavo East National Park, one of Kenya's largest parks, famous for elephants coloured red by its dust, big lion prides and wide open plains. You stay two nights at Voi Wildlife Lodge, whose waterhole draws elephants right past the rooms, and explore Aruba Dam, Mudanda Rock and Lugard Falls on the Galana River before returning to the beach.

Price: from USD 930 per adult sharing (low season estimate). Contact us for your exact dates.
highlights: Pick-up from any beach hotel on the south or north coast
Red elephants, lions and big herds on the Tsavo plains
Aruba Dam, Mudanda Rock and Lugard Falls
Two nights at Voi Wildlife Lodge with a floodlit waterhole

faq.q: How much does this Tsavo East safari from Mombasa cost?
faq.a: It starts from USD 930 per adult sharing with two people in a private vehicle, based on low-season rates. We confirm the price for your dates and pick-up point when you enquire.

faq.q: How far is Tsavo East from the coast?
faq.a: About three hours by road from Mombasa and Diani, and about three and a half hours from Watamu and Malindi.

faq.q: Can we do it in one or two days?
faq.a: Yes, we also run one and two day trips, but three days gives you a full day in the park without long drives on both ends.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Coast to Tsavo East
itinerary.content: Early pick-up from your hotel and drive inland to the Buchuma or Bachuma gate of Tsavo East National Park. Game drive to the lodge. Afternoon game drive. Dinner and overnight at Voi Wildlife Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Tsavo East National Park
itinerary.content: Full day of game drives with a picnic lunch, visiting Aruba Dam, Mudanda Rock and the Galana River at Lugard Falls, looking for elephants, lions, gerenuk and fringe-eared oryx. Dinner and overnight at Voi Wildlife Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Tsavo East to the coast
itinerary.content: Morning game drive, then drive back to your hotel on the coast, arriving in the afternoon.

includes: Private safari vehicle with pop-up roof and English-speaking driver guide
Two nights full board at Voi Wildlife Lodge
Park fees at Tsavo East and Tsavo West (USD 80 per adult per day for non-residents)
Hotel pick-up and drop-off on the Kenya coast
excludes: International flights, visa and travel insurance
Tips for guides and camp staff
Drinks unless stated, laundry and personal expenses
Optional activities not listed in the itinerary
